title: 0060 근무 일정 — 서버만(구성원도 못 읽음), 사람은 구성원 또는 작업자 하나, 한 사람 하루에 한 줄, 서버는 지울 수 있다 (scripts/rls-probe.mjs --migration database/migrations/0060_work_shifts.sql)
setup: INSERT INTO public.companies (id, kind, name, plan, status) VALUES ({{company_x}}, 'partner', 'probe X', 'agent', 'active')
INSERT INTO public.company_members (company_id, user_id, role, status) VALUES ({{company_x}}, {{x_owner_user}}, 'owner', 'active'), ({{company_x}}, {{x_staff_user}}, 'staff', 'active')
INSERT INTO public.work_shifts (id, company_id, member_user_id, work_date, kind, created_by) VALUES ({{shift_a}}, {{company_x}}, {{x_staff_user}}, current_date + 1, 'leave', {{x_owner_user}})

checks.name: 읽기 — 서버만 (대표 · 본인도 브라우저로는 못 읽는다)
checks.sql: select count(*) from public.work_shifts where id = {{shift_a}}

checks.name: 구성원은 쓰지 못한다
checks.sql: insert into public.work_shifts (company_id, member_user_id, work_date, kind) values ({{company_x}}, {{x_staff_user}}, current_date + 2, 'off')

checks.name: 한 사람 하루에 한 줄
checks.sql: insert into public.work_shifts (company_id, member_user_id, work_date, kind) values ({{company_x}}, {{x_staff_user}}, current_date + 1, 'off')

checks.name: 같은 사람 다른 날은 된다
checks.sql: insert into public.work_shifts (company_id, member_user_id, work_date, kind) values ({{company_x}}, {{x_staff_user}}, current_date + 2, 'half')

checks.name: 사람이 없으면 거절
checks.sql: insert into public.work_shifts (company_id, work_date, kind) values ({{company_x}}, current_date + 3, 'off')

checks.name: 종류는 넷만
checks.sql: insert into public.work_shifts (company_id, member_user_id, work_date, kind) values ({{company_x}}, {{x_owner_user}}, current_date + 3, 'work')

checks.name: 종류 바꾸기 — 서버는 고친다
checks.sql: with a as (update public.work_shifts set kind = 'out' where id = {{shift_a}} returning kind) select kind from a

checks.name: 쉬는 날 지우기 — 서버는 지운다
checks.sql: with a as (delete from public.work_shifts where id = {{shift_a}} returning 1) select count(*) from a
